text:
rachel_cs: Quick runbook draft for trial->paid accounts. Goal: keep signup flow median latency <=15s and avoid renewal friction by catching cold-starts early. TL;DR: small prefetch, per-account batching hints, stream first token for UX.

matt_se: Looks good. Can we make a one-paragraph checklist AEs can run before a demo? Short steps they can follow in <2 mins.

sara_customer: A tiny curl warmup example + recommended prefetch TTL would be great. also call out what NOT to prefetch (PII).

rachel_cs: yes — here's a short checklist idea: 1) Confirm model variant in console (prod vs canary) 2) Set prefetch TTL=30s for short trials 3) Enable per-account batching key (account_id) 4) Start streaming=true for first response 5) Monitor warmup success metric and alert if >3 fails in 10m.

matt_se: adding a snippet for warmup (feel free to paste into runbook):

```bash
# warm up model instance for account
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small-optim","input":"Hello" , "account_id":"acct_123","stream":false}'
```

Notes: call this right after signup + again after provisioning dedicated pool. Keep payload minimal to reduce token cost.

devon_support: Important ops note: for Private/VPC customers, do NOT prefetch user PII or complete user documents. Instead prefetch only static prompts/templates. Also include an explicit checklist item for KMS/HSM keys to be accessible to the runtime.

kelly_pm: For renewal risk flags to feed into the health score: - 3+ warmup failures in 24h - 30%+ spike in median latency week-over-week - >10% drop in quality evals on canned prompts - Repeated manual toggles of model variant by customer support. Tag these as "actionable" for AE.

rachel_cs: Good. I'll turn this into a 1-page customer-facing runbook with sections: "What we do (prefetch/batch/stream)", "Checklist for demos", "Risk flags & next steps", "What not to prefetch" and "Support escalation flow".

matt_se: One more micro-optimization to include: use early-kv-cache hints when customers do short-turn convo flows; sample config: `batch.window_ms=25, batch.max_tokens=256` — reduces tail latency when load is low.

sara_customer: Slight UX note: recommend streaming first token within 200-300ms to give perceived speed. If stream isn't feasible, show a loading skeleton and kick warmup earlier in page load. :sparkles:

rachel_cs: Great feedback. I'll add the skeleton UX suggestion and the AE quick-check (2 steps) at the top. Assigning follow-ups: @matt_se (tech sign-off), @devon_support (ops/security callouts), @kelly_pm (renewal flags wording).

onboard-bot: runbook created: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/runbooks/trial-to-paid-warmup-checklist — assigned tags: prefetch, batching, streaming, renewal-risk

matt_se: I'll review by EOD and drop inline comments. Nice concise draft — should help reduce churn from cold-starts. :thumbsup:

rachel_cs: thanks all — will post the final 1-pager in the onboarding folder and ping AEs.
